title: Maintaining Correct Pipe Slope for Reliable Drainage
description: Gravity is the primary driving force behind sanitary drainage systems, making proper horizontal pipe slope an absolute requirement for long-term reliability. If drainage pipes are pitched too steeply, liquid wastewater will rush past solid waste, leaving the solids behind to accumulate and eventually cause severe blockages. Conversely, if the slope is too flat, water velocity drops below the self-scansing rate, leading to sediment buildup. Professional maintenance and installation practices require adhering strictly to local building codes and manufacturer specifications to maintain the correct, steady gradient across every horizontal run.
